_comment: Every pattern `npdev ai relay ingest` uses. Every regex is Python syntax and is compiled with re.MULTILINE | re.IGNORECASE. npdev_relay_ingest.py reads ONLY this file for patterns: to teach ingest a new desire path, add a pattern here and a case in tests/fixtures/relay/build_cases.py, never a literal in code. Paths use forward slashes after normalisation.

pack._comment: Used ONLY by a conversation whose intent is 'pack' (a browser AI writes a reusable pack, not an app). Code stays out: a pack.json carries customCapabilities CONTRACTS only, never code. The relay stores pack.json as <packs workspace>/<packId>/pack.json -- the AI never chooses the folder. example-model.json is an OPTIONAL tiny consumer model that imports the pack by local $ref, used to prove the pack composes.

elements._comment: F4/T4.2 (npdev_relay_elements.py reads ONLY this section for what an element upsert may touch). identityKeys = root arrays of model.schema.json whose elements REQUIRE `name` (test_relay_elements pins that against the schema, so a schema change that drops it fails there). wholeFileOnly = root arrays that cannot be sent as upserts, with the reason shown to the AI. A key in neither list is unknown. shrinkWarnRatio: a replaced element whose JSON is smaller than this share of the old one earns an `element-shrank` warning (an AI that thinks an upsert MERGES sends only the changed fields).

wholeFileOnly.bindings: its elements have no name (a binding is a capability + adapter pair)
wholeFileOnly.conversions: its elements are identified by id, not name
wholeFileOnly.seeds: its elements are identified by id, not name
wholeFileOnly.autoPanels: its elements do not need a name
wholeFileOnly.contexts: each context points at a file of its own
wholeFileOnly.fragments: each fragment points at a file of its own

elisionPatterns.regex: \((unchanged|same as before|as before|inalterado|inalterada|igual|sem mudan\w*|mesmo que antes)\)

promptEcho._comment: Every prompt NPDev composes starts with 'NPDEV-PROMPT <code>-<round>' and ends with 'NPDEV-PROMPT-END <code>-<round>'. Text holding BOTH is the prompt itself (the clipboard still holds it right after COPY), never an answer.
